rn: RN is a radioactive gaseous element formed by the disintegration of radium.
RN can also mean a graduate nurse who has passed examinations for registration.
RN means the same as radon or atomic number 86 or registered nurse.
rna: RNA is a long linear polymer of nucleotides found in the nucleus but mainly in the cytoplasm of a cell where it is associated with microsomes.
For example: "Ribonucleic acid is the genetic material of some viruses."
RNA means the same as ribonucleic acid.
rna polymerase: RNA polymerase is the enzyme that copies DNA into RNA.
RNA polymerase means the same as transcriptase.
rnase: RNase is a transferase that catalyzes the hydrolysis of ribonucleic acid.
RNase means the same as ribonuclease or ribonucleinase.
